title: Convenience
description: This project add quality of life recipe to minecraft
body:
## About the pack
Ever wanted a pack that added balanced features, allowing you to have quality of life recipe in your minecraft world? This datapack was made specifically for that! Added recipe that revolves around improving the overall experience!

## Pack features:
Changes the crafting recipe of leather using hide

An rather balanced way to get hide from rotten flesh

Unpack wool into 2 strings

(check gallery to view additions)

## Optional requirements:
You can also install the optional resourcepack to change the name and texture of rabbit hide to fit better with the changes made by this datapack

## Updates:
Constantly updating the data pack to enhance your vanilla minecraft experience revamping other recipes!
